name: Spine Stance
description: Rise onto a narrow strong stance with qi stacked up the spine like a peak and take the blow on the crown.

name: Flagstone Palm
description: Press the palm forward with the weight of a mountain slope and drive the foe back a pace.

name: Stone Swing
description: Plant one foot hard and swing the other across as if stepping from ledge to ledge.

name: Paired Stones
description: Raise a rough crag at each side then strike between them so the blow is covered from both flanks.

name: Giant Hand
description: Close a huge hand of stone round the target from the ground and squeeze until it breaks the guard.

name: Stone Press
description: Rest a growing weight of stone on the foe's shoulders until they are pressed to a knee.

name: Rock Collapse
description: Break a standing peak of rock above the foes so it falls in heavy pieces over a wide ring.

name: Granite Mantle
description: Wear a thick mantle of stone about the shoulders that turns blows and lends strength to every strike.

name: Pincer Crush
description: Raise two great peaks beside the foe through the qi field and close them together until all between is crushed.

name: Silt Cloak
description: Whirl a cloak of fine silt about the body to blunt a cut or a thrown stone.

name: Silt Drift
description: Let a patch of silt slide under the feet and bear the user quickly to one side.

name: Paired Cobble
description: Fling two cobbles from each hand so they arrive together on different parts of the foe.

name: Mud Seal
description: Slap a thick plug of mud over a foe's mouth or a weapon's hilt to stop it working for a moment.

name: Silt Flood
description: Send a flood of wet silt across the ground that rises to the knees and sets round them.

name: Stone Hail
description: Throw a fan of hard stones high so they fall in a rattling hail on a crowd.

name: Silt Veil
description: Hang a thick veil of drifting silt between user and foe so the foe cannot see where to strike.

name: Silt Burial
description: Pour silt over a group until it covers them to the chest and sets stiff.

name: Paired Landslide
description: Loosen two slopes of earth at once and let them slide together onto the same patch of ground.

name: Entombing Silt
description: Gather silt through the qi field then collapse it over the foes and press it solid so they are entombed.

name: Pooled Strength
description: Hollow the belly and let earth qi pool in it so each blow has more behind it.

name: Bowl Palm
description: Cup the palm and strike so the pooled qi rushes out through its centre.

name: Bowl Guard
description: Hold both hands curved before the chest and catch a blow in the hollow they make.

name: Fill Step
description: Step so the weight settles into the heel like water filling a low place.

name: Gather Grit
description: Draw loose grit and stone qi toward the feet and keep it there ready to be loosed.

name: Overflow Palm
description: Let the stored qi spill from the palm in a heavy thrust that lifts the foe off the ground.

name: Stone Bowl
description: Hollow the ground about the user into a bowl whose rim turns back a rush from every side.

name: Settling Pour
description: Pour a heavy sheet of gravel from the raised hands onto those standing in front.

name: Gathered Foundation
description: Pool qi in a single deep reserve below the feet and let it harden the stance and reinforce every guard.

name: Ring Release
description: Open the pooled qi all at once in a ring of stone that bursts outward from the user.

name: Foundation Overflow
description: Let the whole reserve in the foundation burst upward and outward in a flood of rock that overruns the field.

name: Rock Talon
description: Close the fingers into a hooked claw of rock and rake it through a gap in the guard.

name: Hawk Sense
description: Spread qi through the stone round the user so each movement in the field shows as a small shiver.

name: Updraft Step
description: Push off a rising knob of rock and glide a few paces to the side before landing.

name: Stone Swoop
description: Spring from a raised ledge of stone and strike down at the foe in one swooping bound.

name: Talon Grip
description: Close stone fingers about the foe's limb from the ground and hold them in place.

name: Feather Slate
description: Spread thin sheets of slate about the body like feathers to turn blows aside and let them slip.

name: Rock Strike
description: Rise on a narrow crag and bring a stone-weighted fist down on the foe from above their guard.

name: Hawk Shadow
description: Cast moving shadows of rock across the field to mark every foe and leave their aim unsure.

name: Talon Collapse
description: Gather the stone field into one great claw and bring it down so it pierces the target and drives them to the ground.

name: Azure Foot
description: Plant the foot and let cool pale qi seep into the soil so the stance steadies.

name: Blue Slate
description: Pull a thin pale slab up from the ground and angle it against a cut.

name: Sky Stone
description: Hurl a stone high into the air and bring it down on the foe with a pulse of qi.

name: Bedrock Pulse
description: Send a pulse down to bedrock and read how it returns to learn the hidden shape of the ground.

name: Pale Palm
description: Strike with a palm that glows faintly blue and carries the quiet weight of deep stone.

name: Azure Foundation
description: Hold a lit slab of bedrock under both feet that hardens the guard and lends the strikes weight.

name: Slate Wave
description: Roll a wave of broken slate across the ground in a low sweeping tide.

name: Bedrock Reach
description: Draw the stone at the destination close and step across the gap without crossing the space between.

name: Blue Shard
description: Break off a long shard of bedrock and drive it straight through armor.

name: Bedrock Dominion
description: Make the whole field of stone the user's own so foes inside cannot move freely and are shielded from the user.

name: Heaven Stone
description: Lift a great slab on gathered qi then bring it down edge-first on one target.

name: Azure Cataclysm
description: Raise the pale bedrock through the whole qi field and drop it as one shattering fall on every foe within.

name: Plate Shift
description: Slide one plate of ground against its neighbour under the foe's feet.

name: Parallel Step
description: Step on two tracks of ground at once so the body slides sideways along the nearer track.

name: Grind Palm
description: Strike and then grind the palm across the target so the blow rubs and tears.

name: Fault Read
description: Read the old breaks in the rock beneath and learn which will give under stress.

name: Plate Grind
description: Grind two plates together under the foe so the footing screams and tears.

name: Twin Fault
description: Open two parallel faults in the ground and let each heave up at the same instant.

name: Plate Brace
description: Tilt a whole plate of rock up as a shield and shed the blow along its slope.

name: Tectonic Lock
description: Pin the foes between two plates and hold them there as the plates grind slowly closer.

name: Plate Collision
description: Drive two plates of ground together over the heads of the foes so the ridge between heaves.

name: Tectonic Rend
description: Rend the ground along both tracks at once so a gaping rift opens and tears apart all who stand across it.

name: Broad Stance
description: Spread the feet wide and flat so a shove finds no edge to turn the body.

name: Flat Palm
description: Strike with a palm held flat and hard so the whole face lands at once.

name: Flat Stride
description: Take one long level stride and bring the rear foot up without lifting the body.

name: Level Slam
description: Bring a flat slab of stone down level so it strikes the whole width of the foe at once.

name: Broad Shield
description: Raise a very wide slab of rock that covers the user and the allies standing at the shoulder.

name: Leveling Press
description: Press the ground flat under a foe's feet so they cannot rise on their toes or leap.

name: Bedrock Sweep
description: Sweep a long arm of bedrock across the open ground and knock over all it meets.

name: Held Bedrock
description: Hold the stone beneath firm as a single piece so the user's stance and strength cannot be shaken.

name: Colossal Slab
description: Raise a slab as wide as a hall through the qi field and lay it flat on the foes.

name: Anchor Stone
description: Sink a heavy stone beside the foot and brace against it as a shove arrives.

name: Oath Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries the weight of the vow spoken before it.

name: Vow Stride
description: Take the oath into the step and plant it so it cannot be knocked loose.

name: Vow Pebble
description: Flick a pebble carried through the vow so it strikes where it was sworn to land.

name: Anchor Hold
description: Fix a short stone anchor in the ground and chain the foe's stride to it.

name: Anchor Vow
description: Set an oath-anchor in the stone that holds the user steady and strong against force.

name: Sworn Spike
description: Drive a sworn spike of stone up through the ground and into the foe who broke faith.

name: Binding Vow
description: Bind the foe's limbs with stone roots grown from the oath until they cannot answer.

name: Anchored Rush
description: Charge on a line the oath has fixed and strike with all the held weight at the end.

name: Heavy Oath
description: Lay the full weight of the vow on a foe until their limbs sink under it.

name: Anchor Roots
description: Send roots of stone from the anchor through the ground to grip every foe within reach.

name: Oath Breaker
description: Strike the foe who betrayed the vow with a blow that carries the weight of every anchor set.

name: Oathbound Bedrock
description: Bind the bedrock itself to the oath so allies stand unshaken and foes who face it are pressed down.

name: Windward Rock
description: Raise a rock on the windward side and let the gust break upon it.

name: Gust Pebble
description: Flick a pebble into a passing gust so it flies faster than the arm could throw.

name: Screened Step
description: Step behind a raised stone as the wind rises and cross while the gust is turned.

name: Grit Palm
description: Strike with a palm sheathed in blown grit that scours as well as bruises.

name: Wind Rebuff
description: Catch a blast of wind on tilted stone and turn it back upon the one who sent it.

name: Gale Stone
description: Heave a rain of stones into the gale so they scatter wide across the oncoming line.

name: Wind Rooted
description: Root the stance so deeply in stone that the strongest wind pushes the user nowhere.

name: Gale Turn
description: Turn the whole force of a charging gale along a stone slope and send it back across the foes.

name: Scouring Wave
description: Drive a wave of wind-blown gravel across the ground to strip skin and footing from all it meets.

name: Windward Monolith
description: Raise a great monolith against the wind then let it fall and burst into stone that scours the field.

name: Bearing Stone
description: Set a small stone on the ground and read through it the direction of a distant foe.

name: Course Step
description: Step along a fixed course of firm ground and arrive exactly where intended.

name: True Fist
description: Throw a straight fist along the fixed line so it lands cleanly on the mark.

name: Stone Plank
description: Step onto the foe's line of attack and stand a plank of stone across it.

name: Stone Mark
description: Press a stone mark on the foe's boot that clings and shows where they go.

name: Marked Strike
description: Hit the marked foe with a blow that follows the mark through every dodge.

name: Bearing Spike
description: Send a spike of stone along the bearing through ground to rise under the target.

name: Held Course
description: Keep to the fixed course while a raised slab travels with the body and shields its flank.

name: Unerring Stone
description: Hurl a boulder along the bearing so it follows the foe's movement through the stone beneath them.

name: Course Break
description: Break the fixed line open along its length so the ground heaves under all who stand on it.

name: Bearing Descent
description: Raise a pillar through the field and drop it down the bearing so it lands precisely on the chosen foe.

name: Heavy Stamp
description: Stamp one foot so the ground booms and the foe's balance fails for a moment.

name: Quake Palm
description: Strike so the shock of the blow rolls through the foe's body like a small quake.

name: Rumble Step
description: Take each step as a stamp that drives a low rumble before the user.

name: Rending Quake
description: Rend the surface of the ground in a rolling quake that tears footing from all around.

name: Quake Guard
description: Surround the body with a thin shiver of the earth that rattles weapons from the foe's hands.

name: Shake Lock
description: Keep a low quake going beneath a foe so every limb trembles and none can aim.

name: Rolling Tremor
description: Send long waves of tremor through the ground one after another to wear down a crowd.

name: Heartquake
description: Strike the ground at the centre of a group so the quake throws every body outward.

name: Quake Heart Rend
description: Gather the quake deep in the qi field then burst it upward from the ground's heart in one rending blast.

name: Sworn Base
description: Swear to hold the footing and let the stance turn aside the first blow.

name: Foundation Fist
description: Drive a fist up from the stone beneath so the whole base lands in the blow.

name: Pledged Step
description: Step forward on the vow and bring the foundation along with the foot.

name: Underpin
description: Lay a hard layer of stone under an ally's feet so their stance holds under the next blow.

name: Sworn Pillar
description: Raise a pillar beside user and ally alike that shields them and steadies the footing of both.

name: Footing Lock
description: Lock both feet of a foe into the foundation so they cannot step or turn.

name: Foundation Wave
description: Send a heavy wave through the foundation so it heaves under all who stand on the same ground.

name: Foundation Oath
description: Bind a company of allies to one sworn foundation so each is shielded by the stance of all.

name: Pillar Descent
description: Raise a pillar from the foundation then bring it down on the foe in a single heavy fall.

name: Bedrock Crown Fall
description: Lift a crown of bedrock through the sworn field and let it fall so the foe is struck and pinned beneath.
